_about: DJ Strut, BPM 104.1 "Barn Party Music" (techno-country). Same shape as racers.json: reference = calm neutral lines for the voice's long reference; links = the DJ's lines between songs, by kind; performed = the same links marked up for Drama 3 with a voice-actor direction each.
name: DJ Strut
brief: flashy peacock radio DJ on a techno-country party station: a young American man's bright, punchy hype-man voice, high energy, big grin, rapid-fire radio patter with a little Southern twang, everything is the best thing ever
audition: Yeah! BPM one oh four point one, Barn Party Music! We are locked in at one hundred and twenty-eight beats per minute, and that is a fact!
reference: Hey, it's Strut. I do the afternoon show on BPM, and most of the evening one too.
The studio's in the hayloft over the old dance barn. You can feel the bass through the floor.
I wear the shades indoors because the disco ball is honestly very bright.
Every song we play is somewhere between one twenty and one forty beats per minute.
I keep a little metronome on the desk. It's gold, obviously.
My tail takes about twenty minutes to fold up after a show.
The races use our music too, so if you hear us on the track, that's us.
I've met every racer in the county. Max tips well. The Major does not.
On a quiet night I play the slow ones. Only one or two, though.
The Pit Stop sends over toasties at six. That's the best part of the day.
Most of my mail is song requests. Some of it is about my feathers.
Okay. Headphones on, lights up, let's keep the county moving.

station_intro: Yeah! BPM one oh four point one, Barn Party Music! It's DJ Strut, and that last track, Hay Bale Hyperdrive? Best song ever made. Until this one!
bpm_countdown: We are cruising at one twenty-eight beats per minute. Let's take it to one thirty! One thirty-two! One thirty-five! Whoa, too far. Back to one twenty-eight. Here's Barn Door Breakdown!
traffic: Traffic and travel, Strut style! Landslide on the Pass road, so go round it. Or go over it. I'm not your mum!
joke: Why did the tractor go to the party? It heard there'd be loads of torque! Ha! I'm here all week, Braynard!
racing_report_intro: Shades down, feathers up! It's time for the Racing Report, with Barnaby and Penny, live from the blimp! Hit it!
advert_outro: This hour of Barn Party Music comes to you from the Pit Stop! Tyres, toasties and tow ropes. Strut approved! Keep it loud!
track_intro: Mabel, this one's for you! It's Cowbell Overload, and the cowbell count today is: infinite!
